questions.question: A psalm writer cries out to the LORD from the depths. What does he say is with the LORD?
A psalm writer tells Israel to put their hope in the LORD. What reason does he give?

answers.text: Loving devotion and redemption are with Him
Their enemies have already been defeated
Their harvest will be bigger than ever

questions.question: A psalm writer says the LORD will redeem Israel from all iniquity. True or false?
In a short psalm, David says his soul is stilled and quieted. What does he compare it to?

answers.text: A weaned child with his mother
A ship on a calm sea
